title: incident-bot: enrich on-call context with SLO toolkit telemetry + runbook links
author: Aisha Patel
release_notes: Enrich incident-bot on-call messages with SLO toolkit telemetry context and direct runbook links; adds new telemetry hooks and sanitization for sensitive fields; no breaking changes.
description: Motivation: on-call engineers need richer context in incident-bot alerts to reduce time-to-diagnosis. This PR integrates SLO Toolkit telemetry snapshots into on-call alert messages and attaches prioritized runbook links. Changes are designed to be opt-in via config flags and safe for private deployments. Summary of changes: 1) fetch recent SLO telemetry snapshot for impacted service and attach high-level metrics (error budget, window, current burn rate); 2) include top-3 matching runbook links from the runbook index with confidence scores; 3) add sanitization to avoid leaking PII/keys in message attachments; 4) extend incident-bot message schema and Add a feature flag slo_toolkit.attach_telemetry to control rollout per-org. Testing: added unit tests for telemetry formatting, integration tests mocking SLO Toolkit responses, and e2e smoke test in the perf-canary pipeline. Rollout plan: behind feature flag, staged rollout to 5% of orgs for 48 hours, then 100% with monitoring dashboards. Checklist: [x] unit tests added, [x] integration tests added, [x] docs updated (runbook usage + opt-in flag), [x] feature-flag gating implemented, [x] observability dashboards added. Backwards compatibility: message schema extension is additive and backward compatible. Related: ENG-3245 (SLO oncall context), ENG-3260 (runbook linking enhancements), SUP-1120 (customer escalation for missing runbooks).
